Action.description:
An operation proposed or executed by an actor within the world.

Actions represent operational steps: transferring inventory, dispatching a vehicle,
changing a price, reallocating staff, or issuing a notification.

actor_id.description: Optional identifier of the actor initiating this action.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

parameters.description: Action payload containing target entities, quantities, and parameters.
parameters.title: Parameters

type.description: Action category or schema type identifier.
type.title: Type

Action.title: Action

ComponentVersion.description: Specification of a participating simulation component and its semantic version.

component_id.description: Unique identifier or class name of the component.
component_id.title: Component Id

ComponentVersion.title: ComponentVersion

ConstraintPhase.description:
Execution lifecycle phase at which constraint evaluation is performed.

- PRE_ACTION: Evaluated before action dispatch to validate operational feasibility.
- POST_TRANSITION: Evaluated after dynamics transition to check state invariants.
ConstraintPhase.title: ConstraintPhase

ConstraintResult.description:
Detailed audit record produced when evaluating an operational constraint.

Preserves full constraint provenance:
  - Which constraint was evaluated
  - Its version and semantic definition
  - Whether it was satisfied
  - What entities, resources, and offending values caused the violation
  - What action preceded it

entity_ids.description: Identifiers of entities involved in constraint breach.
entity_ids.title: Entity Ids

penalty.description: Numerical penalty score for soft violations.
penalty.title: Penalty

preceding_action_id.description: Identifier of preceding action that prompted evaluation.
preceding_action_id.title: Preceding Action Id

satisfied.description: True if constraint conditions are met.
satisfied.title: Satisfied

violating_entities.description: Identifiers of entities involved in constraint breach (alias for entity_ids).
violating_entities.title: Violating Entities

violating_resources.description: Identifiers of resources involved in constraint breach.
violating_resources.title: Violating Resources

ConstraintResult.title: ConstraintResult

ConstraintSeverity.description:
Classification of constraint enforcement severity.

- HARD: Inviolable physical, legal, or logistical invariant. Violations invalidate
        an action or abort/penalize a trajectory fatally.
- SOFT: Operational preference, guideline, or non-fatal quality degradation.
        Violations yield warnings and numerical penalty scores.
ConstraintSeverity.title: ConstraintSeverity

Entity.description:
Represents an autonomous, structural, or physical object participating in the world.

Entities represent actors, physical facilities, geographic regions, vehicles,
suppliers, or any discrete organizational participant.

attributes.description: Immutable property map associated with this entity.
attributes.title: Attributes

tags.description: Categorical tags for grouping and querying entities.
tags.title: Tags

Entity.title: Entity

EvidenceLevel.description:
Epistemic classification of dynamics, relationships, and simulation traces.

EWM Engine distinguishes observational correlations from interventional mechanics:
- STRUCTURAL: Grounded in deterministic physical laws, accounting conservation, or hard rules.
- INTERVENTIONAL: Empirically validated under controlled intervention / do-calculus.
- QUASI_CAUSAL: Derived from econometric/quasi-experimental designs (e.g., diff-in-diff, IV).
- PREDICTIVE: Observational statistical or machine-learned association P(Y | X).
- ASSUMED: Working hypothesis or heuristic assumption not yet validated.
EvidenceLevel.title: EvidenceLevel

ExogenousEvent.description:
An external shock or event outside direct policy control.

Examples include weather disruptions, sudden supplier bankruptcy, market demand surges,
traffic accidents, or regulatory shifts.

severity.description: Normalized or absolute event severity measure.
severity.title: Severity

ExogenousEvent.title: ExogenousEvent

Relationship.description:
Represents a directed, typed relational edge between two entities.

Models structural, logistical, dependency, or jurisdictional relations
(e.g., 'supplies', 'depends_on', 'connected_to', 'serves').

attributes.description: Attributes associated with this relation (e.g., distance, bandwidth).
attributes.title: Attributes

Relationship.title: Relationship

Resource.description:
Represents a finite, bounded, or measurable quantity in the enterprise.

Models physical stock, vehicle fleets, operational budgets, bed capacities,
workforce hours, or bandwidth.

current.description: Current quantity or stock of the resource.
current.title: Current

entity_id.description: Optional entity ID owning or hosting this resource.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

max_value.description: Maximum capacity or upper bound limit.
max_value.title: Max Value

Resource.title: Resource

TransitionResult.description:
The result of executing a dynamics transition step.

Contains the resulting next world state, a summary of applied changes,
the epistemic evidence tier, and execution diagnostics.

applied_changes.description: Key deltas, resource flows, and state modifications enacted during transition.
applied_changes.title: Applied Changes

diagnostics.description: Execution metadata, internal model states, and performance metrics.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

evidence_level.description: Epistemic status of the transition mechanism.

model_name.description: Name of the dynamics model producing this result.
model_name.title: Model Name

next_state.description: The evolved world state after dynamics application.

TransitionResult.title: TransitionResult

WorldState.description:
Canonical representation of the enterprise or ecosystem state at a point in time.

Formal Conceptual Representation:
    S_t = (G_t, R_t, M_t, \Gamma_t, C_t)
where:
    G_t = Entities and typed relationships
    R_t = Measurable finite resources and capacities
    M_t = Temporal memory and operational history
    \Gamma_t = Active operational rules and policy parameters
    C_t = Exogenous and environmental context

WorldState is immutable (frozen=True), branchable, serializable, and auditable.

active_rules.description: Active policy parameters, operational thresholds, and rule flags.
active_rules.title: Active Rules

context.description: Environmental, economic, or meteorological context variables.
context.title: Context

entities.description: Active participating entities keyed by EntityId.
entities.title: Entities

memory.description: Relevant temporal memory, running statistics, or history lags.
memory.title: Memory

relationships.description: Immutable sequence of directed relational edges between entities.
relationships.title: Relationships

resources.description: Finite or measurable resources keyed by ResourceId.
resources.title: Resources

WorldState.title: WorldState

description:
Immutable, versioned canonical transition event in the simulation event store.

Captures the exact parent state fingerprint, child state fingerprint, actions,
shocks, applied state changes, constraint violations, and component versions.

actions_accepted.description: Actions accepted after constraint validation and dispatched to dynamics.
actions_accepted.title: Actions Accepted

actions_proposed.description: Actions proposed by policy or actors prior to constraint validation.
actions_proposed.title: Actions Proposed

applied_changes.description: Summary of state deltas and resource flows enacted during transition.
applied_changes.title: Applied Changes

child_fingerprint.description: Canonical SHA-256 fingerprint of the world state resulting from transition.
child_fingerprint.title: Child Fingerprint

component_versions.description: Versions of dynamics, actors, and constraints governing this transition.
component_versions.title: Component Versions

constraint_violations.description: Constraint evaluations or invariant violations recorded during step.
constraint_violations.title: Constraint Violations

exogenous_events.description: Exogenous shocks or environment events sampled during this step.
exogenous_events.title: Exogenous Events

metadata.description: Extensible metadata, scenario context, or execution annotations.
metadata.title: Metadata

parent_fingerprint.description: Canonical SHA-256 fingerprint of the world state prior to transition.
parent_fingerprint.title: Parent Fingerprint

seed.description: Deterministic RNG seed assigned to this rollout step.
seed.title: Seed

state_snapshot.description: Optional full world state snapshot for instant reconstruction or validation.

step_metrics.description: Scalar numerical metrics logged during step.
step_metrics.title: Step Metrics

transition_result.description: Complete transition result including dynamics output and applied changes.
